decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Tarmogoyf while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The key strategy is to maintain control of the board using efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland, while also leveraging card advantage with Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble. This allows the deck to apply pressure early and close out games before the opponent can mount a defense. The deck's tempo-oriented gameplay is further enhanced by the use of cantrips like Ponder and efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo as its win condition. The deck also focuses on artifact synergy, with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Karn, the Great Creator supporting the strategy. It includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke for protection. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently while controlling the game until it can launch its key combo to mill the opponent's library. Additionally, it has a strong mana base and utility lands to support its overall game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. This combo is supported by cards such as Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to search for the necessary pieces, along with disruption spells like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo. The deck also utilizes fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb to accelerate its game plan, while including utility cards like Soul-Guide Lantern and Shadowspear for additional versatility and options.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of lands and land-related abilities. It utilizes cards like Crop Rotation, Exploration, Life from the Loam, and Wasteland to manage the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to create an advantage by generating resources and denying the opponent crucial lands. Additionally, the deck can generate value and incremental advantage through cards like Urza's Saga and Wrenn and Realmbreaker. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds a flexible option for recurring key pieces of the strategy.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Faithless Looting and Entomb, then reanimate them onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This combo strategy aims to cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play, overwhelming the opponent with their presence. Additionally, the deck includes disruption and protection spells like Unmask to help ensure the combo can be executed successfully. The deck aims to win by either overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures or using Tendrils of Agony for a lethal storm finish.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get Death's Shadow on the field as a powerful threat, using cards like Reanimate and Grief to bring it out early. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Stubborn Denial to protect Death's Shadow, as well as removal spells such as Snuff Out to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Baleful Strix and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Wasteland.

The deck focuses on playing threats early, disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and removal spells, and maintaining tempo through efficient card selection and mana denial. Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent are key threats that can pressure the opponent quickly, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help dig for answers or threats. Force of Will and Daze provide strong interaction against opposing spells, while Wasteland disrupts the opponent's mana base. The deck aims to control the board and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain aggressive tempo through efficient control spells like Daze and Force of Will, while also utilizing disruptive land destruction with Wasteland. Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent provide quick threats, backed up by counter magic like Spell Pierce and Brainstorm for card advantage. Dragon's Rage Channeler helps to filter cards and provide additional pressure. The deck aims to quickly control the board and push for lethal damage, utilizing a mix of powerful creatures and efficient spells to maintain pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting your opponent's game plan while developing your own threats. Utilizing a combination of hand disruption spells and powerful removal, it aims to control the board and tempo of the game. With a mixture of powerful creatures like Uro and Baleful Strix, as well as efficient cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder, the deck can generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck's versatility allows it to adapt to a variety of matchups and generate incremental advantage to come out on top.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Cephalid Illusionist combo, with Nomads en-Kor to fill the graveyard with creatures, then using Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It also includes disruption through counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, along with hand disruption like Cabal Therapy. The deck also includes a few key utility cards like Stoneforge Mystic to fetch equipment like Shuko and Kaldra Compleat. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces while disrupting the opponent to secure a win.

The deck focuses on creating a combo using Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire deck. It utilizes cards like Goblin Welder, Goblin Engineer, and Urza's Saga to find and protect the combo pieces. Other cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ensnaring Bridge help control the board while the combo is set up. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game in a single turn.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere to restrict their mana and spells. The aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss put pressure on the opponent while also benefiting from the disruptive elements of the deck. The inclusion of dragons like Fury and Cursed Mirror provide powerful finishers to quickly end the game. Overall, the deck focuses on denying the opponent resources and overwhelming them with efficient threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient low-cost spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats quickly. The deck features a lot of cantrips and cheap counterspells to ensure consistent draws and protect its creatures. Dragon's Rage Channeler, Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Sprite Dragon are the key threats that can quickly end the game if left unchecked. Wasteland is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base while Lightning Bolt provides additional reach. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

The main concept of this Bant Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the board through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. The deck aims to draw cards and generate card advantage while also putting pressure on the opponent with flying shark tokens from Shark Typhoon. Cards like Hullbreacher and Narset, Parter of Veils also provide ways to limit the opponent's resources, while Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath provides value and a threat that can take over the game if left unchecked.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. It utilizes efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as countermagic in Force of Will and Force of Negation. The deck also has access to powerful card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder, while also having threats in Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. The mana base is designed to support these spells and ensure consistency in casting them.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal spells while using card draw and manipulation to set up powerful plays. The deck aims to control the opponent's board and disrupt their game plan, ultimately achieving victory through card advantage and overwhelming them with powerful threats. It utilizes a combination of control planeswalkers, efficient removal spells, and versatile counterspells to maintain control of the game and dictate the pace. Additionally, the deck includes some alternative win conditions and anti-land strategies to further disrupt the opponent's resources.
